nodes.name: Facebook Lead Ads Trigger
nodes.notes: Fires when someone submits a Facebook Lead Ad form. Connect your Facebook Page via OAuth.

nodes.name: Map FB Fields
nodes.notes: Flatten Facebook field_data[] into a clean object and normalise the phone to E.164 (+91 default)

nodes.name: Save to CRM
nodes.notes: POST lead into crm_leads via existing marketing-leads endpoint

nodes.name: WhatsApp Follow-up
nodes.notes: Send instant WhatsApp reply to the lead. Continues even if this fails.

nodes.name: Has Phone?
nodes.notes: Only send WhatsApp if phone number is present
